metadata.title: Discovery of WINERED-HVS1: A metal-rich hyper-velocity star candidate ejected from the Galactic center

notes: No eligible stars. The paper explicitly states that all 74 kinematically selected HVS candidates are bound to the Milky Way (T:p5-b11), and the final 22 metal-rich candidates, including WINERED-HVS1 (Gaia DR3 6434696676903108864), are also described as gravitationally bound (T:p12-b2; T:p22-b3); the abstract likewise calls WINERED-HVS1 gravitationally bound (T:p1-b10). The previously known unbound stars HVS1 and S5-HVS1 are only cited as literature context (T:p2-b3), not studied here as follow-up targets.
